items.question: How are the stated-count letters used in constructing the yantra?
items.inference: the construction begins from the stated letter set

items.question: What placement of maya and name-triangle follows the initial making?
items.inference: the yantra is arranged with maya centrally and name in triangle
items.plain_english: Having made, place maya in the middle, making the name enter the triangle.

items.question: Where is the fourteen-syllable matrka written in the yantra?
items.inference: the matrka is inscribed in the central circle
uncertainties: whether caturdaśārṇam modifies matrka or another element
items.plain_english: Write the fourteen-syllable matrka in the middle of the circle.

items.question: Which yantra is completed with the shakti-amrita pentad?
premises: it is completed with shakti-amrita pentad
items.inference: the thirty-third yantra includes the shakti-amrita pentad
items.plain_english: The thirty-third yantra, with the shakti-amrita pentad.

items.question: In which bodily conditions and locations is this yantra applied?
premises: eyes and belly-born condition are named
items.inference: the yantra's use extends to sphota, smallpox, eyes, and belly-born affliction
uncertainties: whether these are separate applications or one combined rite
items.plain_english: In sphota, in smallpox, and in the eyes and belly-born condition.

items.question: Where does the described procedure apply among letter-yantras?
items.inference: the same procedure is used in all letter-yantras
uncertainties: whether sarvatrā modifies scope or emphasis

items.question: How many square compartments arise in the cakra when worship is performed with two hundred ninety-six by them?
premises: Two hundred ninety-six are used by them.
items.inference: Therefore the cakra has square compartments arising from that worship.
uncertainties: Exact grammatical case of śatadvayam and koṣṭhāni is not fully resolved.
items.plain_english: Hear, goddess; I will declare by all-limbs yoga. Two hundred ninety-six by them; the cakra there worship. By that square compartments arise, Parvati.
